body:
### Summary

When try to use `uv run -p 3.14 napari` in freshly cloned napari project (https://github.com/napari/napari/ sha: 8ad9a217b4dbcae0241907376cfef4d0edfcedae) It tries to install `numpy` in version 2.2.6. While this numpy do not provide a wheels for python 3.14. 

Based on our experiments it comes from this line from optional dependecies

```
"numba>=0.58.0,<=0.62.1 ; platform_system == 'Darwin' and platform_machine == 'x86_64'",
```

This line is to limit numba version on `macos-intel` platform as `numba==0.63.0` dropped support for this platform and there is no other way to prevent building from source 

when run `uv run -p 3.13 napari` it resolves but still ship older numpy and numba that might have performance impact. 


[Verbose output](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34343028/uv_out.txt)

### Platform

Windows 11

### Version

uv 0.13.7 (316c827e0 2026-11-03 x86_64-pc-windows-msvc)

### Python version

3.14
title: uv run --python 3.14 attempts to build locked NumPy 2.2.6 from source when a newer release has a compatible wheel
